name: npm-automations
description: Runs an async lockfile-frozen install (npm ci / pnpm install --frozen-lockfile / yarn install --frozen-lockfile, picked by whichever lockfile is present) when a project is entered via EnterWorktree (toggle: npm_ci_on_worktree), and an async, dependency-scoped install whenever a package.json's dependencies actually change (toggle: npm_install_on_package_change) — moved out of coding-toolbox to centralize npm-lifecycle automation hooks.

npm_ci_on_worktree.title: Auto clean install on worktree entry
npm_ci_on_worktree.description: When entering a git worktree (EnterWorktree) whose project has a lockfile, runs that manager's frozen-lockfile install there in the background: npm ci (package-lock.json), pnpm install --frozen-lockfile (pnpm-lock.yaml), or yarn install --frozen-lockfile (yarn.lock) — pnpm/yarn take priority over npm when more than one lockfile is present. Values: true (or unset) = enabled; false = disabled. Fail-open: only the literal value false disables it. Default: true.

npm_install_on_package_change.title: Auto install on package.json dependency change
npm_install_on_package_change.description: After a Write/Edit to any package.json whose dependencies/devDependencies/optionalDependencies actually changed, runs an install scoped to only the changed specs in the background (npm install/pnpm add/yarn add, picked by whichever lockfile is present, defaulting to npm when none exists yet) — a version-only (or other non-dependency) change triggers no call. Values: true (or unset) = enabled; false = disabled. Fail-open: only the literal value false disables it. Default: true.
